parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the vulnerability whitelist.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason for adding the whitelist.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the whitelist. Valid values:
- **image**: image
- **agentless**: agentless.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description:
The operation target. This parameter is in JSON format and contains the following fields:

- **type**: The target type. Set to repo.
- **target**: The target content. Format: namespace/image repository.
